title_en: Notice of the General Office of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Styles of Criminal Judgments for First-instance Juvenile Criminal Cases Applying Ordinary Procedure and for First-instance Juvenile Criminal Public Prosecution Cases Applying Summary Procedure
keywords_en: issuance of first instance juvenile criminal case; first instance juvenile criminal public prosecution case
full_text_en:
General Office of the Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Style of Criminal Judgment for First Instance Juvenile Criminal Cases Applying Ordinary Procedure and the Style of Criminal Judgment for First Instance Juvenile Criminal Public Prosecution Cases Applying Summary Procedure

Fa Ban Fa [2009] No. 25

All local people's courts at various levels nationwide, all military courts at various levels, all railway transport intermediate courts and basic courts, all maritime courts, and all courts of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

Based on the practical needs of juvenile criminal case trials, we hereby issue to you the Style of Criminal Judgment for First Instance Juvenile Criminal Cases Applying Ordinary Procedure and the Style of Criminal Judgment for First Instance Juvenile Criminal Public Prosecution Cases Applying Summary Procedure. Please implement them conscientiously.

As of June 11, 2001, the General Office of the Supreme People's Court issued the Notice on Issuing Four Supplementary Styles Including the Style of Criminal Judgment for First Instance Juvenile Criminal Cases Applying Ordinary Procedure (Fa Ban Fa [2001] No. 1). Supplementary Style 2 of the Court Criminal Litigation Document Styles, namely the Style of Criminal Judgment for First Instance Juvenile Criminal Cases Applying Ordinary Procedure, shall no longer be implemented.

October 12, 2009

People's Court

Criminal Judgment

(For use in first instance juvenile criminal cases applying ordinary procedure)

(   ) Xing Chu Zi No.

Prosecutorial Authority:    People's Procuratorate.

Defendant: ... (state the name, gender, date of birth, ethnicity, domicile registration location, education level, occupation or work unit, school, address, details of compulsory measures taken, etc., current place of detention).

Legal Representative: ... (state the name, relationship with the defendant, work unit and position, address).

Defense Counsel (or appointed defense counsel): ... (state the name, work unit and position).

The People's Procuratorate, by indictment No. [   ] Jian Su [   ], charged the defendant with the crime of ... and initiated a public prosecution before this court on ... (year) ... (month) ... (day). This court filed the case on ... (year) ... (month) ... (day), and formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law. Because the defendant in this case is a minor (or because this case involves a minor defendant), the trial was conducted in camera in accordance with the law. The People's Procuratorate designated a prosecutor to appear in court to support the prosecution. The victim and his/her legal representative, agent ad litem, the defendant and his/her legal representative, defense counsel (or appointed defense counsel), witnesses, expert witnesses, interpreters, and others appeared in court to participate in the proceedings. The trial has now concluded.

The People's Procuratorate charged that: ... (summarize the facts, evidence, and legal opinion on which the People's Procuratorate based its charges against the defendant).

The defendant argued that: ... (summarize the defendant's confession, defense, self-representation opinions and related evidence regarding the charged criminal facts). The legal representative: ... (summarize the opinions on the prosecutorial authority's charges against the defendant and the related evidence provided). The defense counsel put forward the following defense opinions: ... (summarize the defense counsel's opinions and related evidence).

In accordance with the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Trying Juvenile Criminal Cases, a survey report on the defendant's background was submitted to the court.

Upon trial, it is found that: ... (first, state the facts found by the court trial; second, state the evidence confirmed by the court and its source; finally, analyze and authenticate the facts and evidence disputed by the prosecution and defense).

During the trial, the court learned that: ... (summarize the content of the defendant's background survey report that is closely related to sentencing). The prosecution and defense expressed the following opinions on the defendant's background survey report: ... (if the defendant is likely to be sentenced to a non-custodial penalty, summarize the conditions of guardianship, assistance, and education available, etc.).

This court holds that: ... (based on the facts, evidence, and relevant legal provisions confirmed by investigation, argue whether the prosecution's charges are established, whether the defendant's conduct constitutes a crime, what crime is committed, and whether there should be a lighter, mitigated, exempted, or heavier punishment. For opinions of the prosecution and defense regarding the application of law, there should be an analysis indicating whether to accept them and the reasons. If the minor defendant is found guilty, combine the investigated growth experience of the minor defendant to analyze the subjective and objective reasons for the minor defendant embarking on the path of crime). In accordance with the provisions of ... (state the legal basis for the judgment), the judgment is as follows:

... (state the judgment result). Divided into four situations:

First, conviction and imposition of punishment: state as:

"1. The defendant committed the crime of ... and is sentenced to ... (state the principal penalty and supplementary penalty). (The term of imprisonment shall be calculated from the date the judgment takes effect. Any period of detention prior to the execution of the judgment shall be deducted from the term of imprisonment, one day of detention being equivalent to one day of imprisonment, i.e., from ... (year) ... (month) ... (day) to ... (year) ... (month) ... (day).)

2. The defendant ... (state the decision to recover, refund, or return to the victim, or confiscate property, including its name, type, and amount)."

Second, conviction but exemption from punishment: state as:

"The defendant committed the crime of ... and is exempted from criminal punishment (if there are recoveries, refunds, or confiscations of property, continue with a second item)."

Third, where the defendant is not subjected to criminal punishment because he/she is under the age of 16: state as:

"The defendant bears no criminal liability."

Fourth, acquittal, whether applying Article 162, item (2) or item (3) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, shall be stated as:

"The defendant is innocent."

If不服 this judgment, an appeal may be lodged within ten days from the day following receipt of the judgment, either through this court or directly with the higher people's court. If an appeal is submitted in writing, one original and   copies of the appeal petition shall be submitted.

Presiding Judge

People's Assessor

People's Assessor

... (year) ... (month) ... (day)

(Court Seal)

Clerk

Explanation of the Style

I. This style is formulated in accordance with the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Trying Juvenile Criminal Cases, and the practical needs of trying juvenile criminal cases. It is for use by first instance people's courts when applying ordinary procedure in trying juvenile criminal cases.

II. Juvenile crimes are different from adult crimes. When drafting a juvenile criminal judgment, the policy of "education, persuasion, and salvage" and the principle of "education as the main focus, punishment as the supplement" should be fully reflected based on the actual circumstances of the case, reflecting the characteristics of "integrating education into trial and combining punishment with education."

III. The language of juvenile criminal adjudicative documents should be concise, easy to understand, and focus on reasoning, making it convenient for the minor defendant and his/her legal representative to understand.

IV. Heading

1. Basic information of the minor defendant

(1) Name and domicile registration location. The investigated name and domicile registration location of the minor defendant shall be stated. If the minor defendant falls under the circumstances of Article 128, paragraph 2 of the Criminal Procedure Law which states "for cases where the criminal facts are clear, and the evidence is reliable and sufficient, the case may also be transferred to the People's Procuratorate for examination and prosecution in accordance with the defendant's self-reported name," the name may be stated according to the defendant's self-reported name, but it should be noted with "(self-reported)" in parentheses. The domicile registration location may be omitted.

If the defendant's self-reported name is inconsistent across investigation, prosecution, and trial stages, the judge shall determine it comprehensively based on the circumstances of the case.

(2) Date of birth. The investigated year, month, and day of the minor defendant's birth shall be stated. If it falls under the circumstances of Article 4, paragraph 1 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in Trying Juvenile Criminal Cases, which states "if there is insufficient evidence to prove that the defendant had reached the statutory age of criminal responsibility at the time of committing the alleged crime and it is truly impossible to ascertain, it shall be presumed that he/she had not reached the corresponding statutory age of criminal responsibility," it may be stated as "under fourteen years of age at the time of committing the alleged crime," "over fourteen but under sixteen years of age at the time of committing the alleged crime," and "over sixteen but under eighteen years of age at the time of committing the alleged crime," respectively, with "(presumed)" noted in parentheses.

If it falls under paragraph 2, which states "relevant evidence is sufficient to prove that the defendant had reached the statutory age of criminal responsibility at the time of committing the alleged crime, but the specific date of birth of the defendant cannot be accurately ascertained," the heading shall directly state that the defendant "was over [age] years old at the time of committing the alleged crime."

(3) Education level. The actual schooling status shall be stated. For example, it may be stated as "second grade of primary school, dropped out" or "first grade junior high school student," etc.

(4) Work unit, school, address. The investigated work unit, school, and address shall be stated. If the domicile registration location and address are consistent, the address may be omitted. If the crime was committed outside the domicile registration location, the address before compulsory measures were taken or the habitual residence shall be stated.

If it falls under the circumstances of Article 128, paragraph 2 of the Criminal Procedure Law, it may be omitted.

(5) Compulsory measures taken. Stated as "for suspected crime, was criminally detained and arrested (or subjected to other compulsory measures) on ... (year) ... (month) ... (day)."

(6) The heading shall state whether there have been prior criminal punishments due to crimes.

2. Legal representative

(1) If the minor defendant has no legal representative or the legal representative cannot be located, the legal representative may be omitted.

(2) If the minor defendant's legal representative cannot appear in court or is indeed unsuitable to appear, the legal representative shall be stated, and in the trial process section of the court appearance personnel, it shall be stated as: "the defendant's legal representative, though notified by the court, did not appear in court" or "the defendant's legal representative did not appear in court due to special reasons," etc.

(3) If the defendant was a minor at the time of committing the crime but has reached adulthood at the time of trial, no legal representative shall be listed.

3. If a social investigator participates in the trial, after "interpreters" in the trial process section, add: "interpreters, social investigators, and others appeared in court to participate in the proceedings. The trial has now concluded."

4. For juvenile criminal cases subject to designated jurisdiction, in the trial process section, it may be stated as: "In accordance with the decision on designated jurisdiction by the intermediate people's court, the People's Procuratorate, by indictment No. [ ] Jian Su [ ]..." directly following the trial process section.

V. Facts

(1) When summarizing the defendant's personality traits, family situation, social interactions, growth experience, and performance before and after committing the alleged crime, it should be concise and pay attention to protecting the privacy of the minor defendant and his/her family. Only content closely related to the defendant's sentencing need be stated.

Opinions expressed by the prosecution and defense regarding the content of the minor defendant's survey report should be objectively stated.

If the people's court investigates the minor defendant's background on its own, after stating the facts and evidence found during the trial, it may state: "In accordance with the provisions of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Trying Juvenile Criminal Cases, through this court's own investigation, it is learned that..."

(2) In the facts section, attention should be paid to stating the evidence regarding the minor defendant's age; the opinions of the prosecution and defense on the age and evidence; and analysis and authentication of age and evidence disputed by the prosecution and defense.

VI. Reasoning

Attention should be paid to stating the reasons for determining or presuming the age of the minor defendant at the time of committing the crime.

For cases where the defendant's age is presumed in accordance with Article 4, paragraph 1 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in Trying Juvenile Criminal Cases, in the "This court holds that" section, it may be stated as: "Given that through court investigation the defendant's year, month, and day of birth truly cannot be ascertained, this court, based on the available evidence, presumes in accordance with the law that the defendant was under fourteen years of age at the time of committing the alleged crime (or was over fourteen but under sixteen years of age at the time of committing the alleged crime, or was under eighteen years of age at the time of committing the alleged crime)."

VII. For minor victims in privacy cases, to protect the victim's reputation, only the surname, not the given name, shall be stated in the adjudicative document, expressed as "Zhang Mou" or "Wang Moumou."

If a minor victim in a privacy case files an incidental civil action, the true name shall be stated in the "Incidental Civil Plaintiff" section of the heading.

For witnesses in juvenile criminal cases, their true names shall be stated.

VIII. For first instance incidental civil judgments involving minor defendants, reference may be made to Styles 3, 6, and 9 of the Court Criminal Litigation Document Styles (Samples) and their explanations. For second instance incidental civil judgments, reference may be made to Styles 12 and 15 of the Court Criminal Litigation Document Styles (Samples) and their explanations.

IX. For second instance criminal judgments and rulings involving minor defendants, reference may be made to this style and Styles 11, 13, 16, 17, and 18 of the Court Criminal Litigation Document Styles (Samples) and their explanations.

People's Court

Criminal Judgment

(For use in first instance juvenile criminal public prosecution cases applying summary procedure)

(day). This court filed the case on ... (year) ... (month) ... (day), and applied summary procedure in accordance with the law, with a single judge trial. Because the defendant in this case is a minor (or because this case involves a minor defendant), the trial was conducted in camera in accordance with the law. (The prosecutor of the People's Procuratorate,) the defendant and his/her legal representative, defense counsel (or appointed defense counsel), and others appeared in court to participate in the proceedings. The trial has now concluded.

The prosecutorial authority charged the defendant: ... (briefly summarize the content of the criminal facts charged in the indictment).

The above facts were not disputed by the defendant during the trial, and are confirmed by physical evidence, documentary evidence, testimony of witnesses, statements of the victim, investigation and inspection records and expert conclusions of the public security organs (or procuratorial organs), and other evidence, which are sufficient to establish.

In accordance with the provisions of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Trying Juvenile Criminal Cases, during the court trial, this court learned that: ... (briefly summarize the content of the defendant's background survey report closely related to sentencing. If the defendant is likely to be sentenced to a non-custodial penalty, summarize the conditions of guardianship, assistance, and education available, etc.).

This court holds that: the defendant's conduct (specific) has constituted the crime of ... The defendant committed the crime of ... and is sentenced to ... (state the specific content of the sentence). (The term of imprisonment shall be calculated from the date the judgment takes effect. Any period of detention prior to the execution of the judgment shall be deducted from the term of imprisonment, one day of detention being equivalent to one day of imprisonment, i.e., from ... (year) ... (month) ... (day) to ... (year) ... (month) ... (day).)

If不服 this judgment, an appeal may be lodged within ten days from the day following receipt of the judgment, either through this court or directly with the higher people's court. If an appeal is submitted in writing, one original and   copies of the appeal petition shall be submitted.

... (year) ... (month) ... (day)

(Court Seal)

Explanation of the Style

I. This style is formulated on the basis of the Style of Criminal Judgment for First Instance Public Prosecution Cases Applying Summary Procedure (Fa Fa [2003] No. 6), in line with the principle of simplifying adjudicative documents as much as possible when applying summary procedure in criminal cases. Compared with the Style of Criminal Judgment for First Instance Public Prosecution Cases Applying Summary Procedure, this style adds content on the "defendant's background survey report" and parts such as "analyzing the subjective and objective reasons for the minor defendant embarking on the path of crime."

II. The content within parentheses "( )" is content that should be stated according to the specific circumstances of the case; if there are no corresponding matters, it need not be stated.

III. The criminal judgment for first instance juvenile criminal public prosecution cases applying summary procedure may be made with reference to the style of criminal judgment for first instance juvenile criminal cases applying ordinary procedure and its explanation.
